arxiv-2011-08582.title: Chen and Casorati curvature inequalities for the submanifolds of quaternionic Kaehler manifolds endowed with Ricci quarter-symmetric metric connection.
arxiv-2011-08582.creator: Umair Ali Wani, Mehraj Ahmad Lone
arxiv-2011-08582.description: Abstract Abstract: In this paper, authors have established Chen’s inequalties for the submanifolds of quaternionic Kaehler manifolds characterized by Ricci quarter-symmetric metric connection. Other than these inequalities, we have also derived generalized normalized Casorati curvature inequalities for the same submanifolds. Keywords: Chen Inequalities; Ricci quarter-symmetric metric connection; Casorati curvature; quaternionic Kaehler manifolds.

arxiv-2111-09931.title: DawDreamer: Bridging the Gap Between Digital Audio Workstations and Python Interfaces
arxiv-2111-09931.description: Abstract Audio production techniques which previously only existed in GUI-constrained digital audio workstations, live-coding environments, or C++ APIs are now accessible with our new Python module called DawDreamer. DawDreamer therefore bridges the gap between real sound engineers and coders imitating them with offline batch-processing.

arxiv-2209-06501.title: Posterior predictive distributions of neutron-deuteron cross sections
arxiv-2209-06501.creator: Sean B. S. Miller, Andreas Ekström, Christian Forssén
arxiv-2209-06501.description: Abstract We quantify the posterior predictive distributions (PPDs) of elastic neutron-deuteron ( n ​ d nd ) scattering cross sections using nucleon-nucleon ( N ​ N NN ) interactions from chiral effective field theory ( χ \chi EFT) up to and including next-to-next-to-next-to-leading order (N 3 LO).

arxiv-2307-14488.title: COUNTING EISENSTEIN POLYNOMIALS SATISFYING A CONDITION FROM GENUS THEORY
arxiv-2307-14488.creator: Jongwoo Choi and Kevin J. McGown
arxiv-2307-14488.description: Abstract Abstract We give an asymptotic formula for the number of monic Eisenstein polynomials of odd prime degree satisfying an additional condition that arises in the study of the genus number of an algebraic number field. 1 Introduction Let d denote an odd prime throughout.

arxiv-2401-09076.title: Benchmarking Quantum Computer Simulation Software Packages: State Vector Simulators
arxiv-2401-09076.creator: Amit Jamadagni, Andreas M. Läuchli, Cornelius Hempel
arxiv-2401-09076.description: Abstract Rapid advances in quantum computing technology lead to an increasing need for software simulators that enable both algorithm design and the validation of results obtained from quantum hardware. This includes calculations that aim at probing regimes of quantum advantage, where a quantum computer outperforms a classical computer in the same task.

PNPLA3 has previously been associated with adult obesity. Here we investigated the possible association between genetic variants in these genes and

pmc-10482348.title: Avidity-based biosensors for ubiquitylated PCNA reveal choreography of DNA damage bypass
pmc-10482348.creator: George Yakoub, Yun-Seok Choi, Ronald P. Wong, Tina Strauch, Kezia J. Ann, Robert E. Cohen, Helle D. Ulrich
pmc-10482348.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In eukaryotes, the posttranslational modifier ubiquitin is used to regulate the amounts, interactions, or activities of proteins in diverse pathways and signaling networks. Its effects are mediated by monoubiquitin or polyubiquitin chains of varying geometries. We describe the design, validation, and application of a series of avidity-based probes against the ubiquitylated forms of the DNA replication clamp, proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA), in budding yeast.

pmc-10543362.title: Do young people perceive their smartphone addiction as problematic? A study in Danish university college students
pmc-10543362.creator: Gitte Frydenlund, Julie Dalgaard Guldager, Katrine Oertel Frederiksen, Heidi Klakk Egebæk
pmc-10543362.description: As smartphone addiction has been linked to poor mental health and lower levels of physical activity, it is of public health interest to explore the behavior behind problematic smartphone use and develop interventions to reduce smartphone use. This study aimed to investigate the risk of smartphone addiction and examine perceived problematic smartphone behavior among university college students.

pmc-10774025.title: Initial experience in robot-associated radical nephrectomy with inferior vena cava tumor thrombectomy
pmc-10774025.creator: Kojiro Ohba, Kensuke Mitsunari, Hiromi Nakanishi, Takuji Yasuda, Yuichiro Nakamura, Tomohiro Matsuo, Yasushi Mochizuki, Ryoichi Imamura
pmc-10774025.description: BackgroundRenal cell carcinoma (RCC) is often locally invasive and may extend from the renal vein into the inferior vena cava (IVC) as a venous tumor thrombus (VTT). Radical nephrectomy with IVC tumor thrombectomy (IVC-TT) via an open approach has been shown to carry high morbidity and mortality.

pmc-11357221.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Replacement for Animal Experiments in Neurology: Potential, Progress, and Challenges
pmc-11357221.creator: Thorsten Rudroff
pmc-11357221.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Animal experimentation has long been a cornerstone of neurology research, but it faces growing scientific, ethical, and economic challenges. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are providing new opportunities to replace animal testing with more human-relevant and efficient methods. This article explores the potential of AI technologies such as brain organoids, computational models, and machine learning to revolutionize neurology research and reduce reliance on animal models.

pmc-11662442.title: Convergent Emergence of Glucomannan β-Galactosyltransferase Activity in Asterids and Rosids
pmc-11662442.creator: Konan Ishida, Matthew Penner, Kenji Fukushima, Yoshihisa Yoshimi, Louis F L Wilson, Alberto Echevarría-Poza, Li Yu, Paul Dupree
pmc-11662442.description: β-Galactoglucomannan (β-GGM) is a primary cell wall polysaccharide in rosids and asterids. The β-GGM polymer has a backbone of repeating β-(1,4)-glucosyl and mannosyl residues, usually with mono-α-(1,6)-galactosyl substitution or β-(1,2)-galactosyl α-galactosyl disaccharide side chains on the mannosyl residues. Mannan β-galactosyltransferases (MBGTs) are therefore required for β-GGM synthesis.

pmc-11713012.title: Evaluation of serum level of seven Sirtuins in Alzheimer’s Disease patients: Biomarker based on the Translational Research
pmc-11713012.creator: Abhinay Kumar Singh, Rashmita Pradhan, Prasun Chatterjee, Sharmistha Dey
pmc-11713012.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most prevalent neurodegenerative disorder. Dysfunction of mitochondria and oxidative stress are known to aggravate the disease pathology. Sirtuins, NAD‐dependent deacetylases, have a well‐defined role in this pathway and thus can serve as a potential biomarker for the early detection of the disease.

pmc-11726081.title: A comprehensive consolidation of data on the connection between CDKN2A polymorphisms and the susceptibility to childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia
pmc-11726081.creator: Maryam Aghasipour, Fatemeh Asadian, Seyed Alireza Dastgheib, Abolhasan Alijanpour, Ali Masoudi, Maedeh Barahman, Mohammad Golshan-Tafti, Reza Bahrami, Amirmasoud Shiri, Hossein Aarafi, Kazem Aghili, Hossein Neamatzadeh
pmc-11726081.description: BackgroundAcute lymphoblastic leukemia is the predominant neoplastic ailment in childhood. Prior research has already established noteworthy connections between CDKN2A polymorphisms and susceptibility to this childhood leukemia, however, substantial associations are still awaiting validation. This investigation was undertaken to examine the correlation between CDKN2A polymorphisms and the risk of acute lymphoblastic leukemia in children.

pmc-12448458.title: Tirzepatide compared with semaglutide and 10-year cardiovascular disease risk reduction in obesity: post-hoc analysis of the SURMOUNT-5 trial
pmc-12448458.creator: Mamas A Mamas, Harold Bays, Runjia Li, Navneet Upadhyay, Tanya Irani, Cagri Senyucel, Julia P Dunn, Hong Liu-Seifert
pmc-12448458.description: AimsApproximately two-thirds of obesity-related mortality is attributable to cardiovascular disease (CVD). The aim of this analysis is to examine predicted CVD risk reduction following weight loss in persons with obesity for primary prevention between tirzepatide and semaglutide, and projected CVD events that could be potentially prevented in the USA.

pmc-12566268.title: Integrated Pathogen–Host Analysis of Citrobacter braakii SCGY-1L: Genomic Determinants and Host Transcriptional Dynamics During Infection
pmc-12566268.creator: Zhixiu Wang, Tingting Zhou, Shaoxuan Gu, Jiaqi Yao, Suli Liu, Jiaming Mao
pmc-12566268.description: Citrobacter braakii is an emerging opportunistic pathogen of escalating clinical significance in animal hosts, though its pathogenic mechanisms remain poorly characterized. This study isolated a C. braakii strain (SCGY-1L) from diseased Siniperca chuatsi and confirmed its identity through integrated morphological, physiological, and molecular analyses. Comprehensive genomic sequencing revealed a 5.75 Mb genome comprising one circular chromosome and two plasmids.

pmc-12643787.title: Percutaneous Interventional Procedures for Bile Duct Injuries
pmc-12643787.creator: Shiro Miyayama, Masashi Yamashiro, Rie Ikeda, Takumi Sugiura, Seitaro Ishikawa, Naoko Sakuragawa, Takuro Terada, Taku Sanada
pmc-12643787.description: Percutaneous interventions are widely performed for bile duct injuries due to surgery, trauma, and local ablation or transarterial chemoembolization for hepatocellular carcinoma. Most bilomas can be treated with percutaneous drainage alone, but additional biliary drainage or plastic stenting in the common bile duct, dilation of the coexisting biliary stricture, or embosclerosis is also required for refractory bilomas.

pmc-12653540.title: Quantifying Morphological Change in Stage III Lipedema: A 3D Imaging Study of Population Trends and Individual Treatment Courses
pmc-12653540.creator: Niels A. Sanktjohanser, Nikolaus Thierfelder, Benjamin Beck, Sinan Mert, Benedikt Fuchs, Paul S. Wiggenhauser, Riccardo E. Giunta, Konstantin C. Koban
pmc-12653540.description: Background/Objectives: Lipedema is a chronic disorder characterized by disproportionate fat accumulation in the extremities, causing pain, bruising, and reduced mobility. When conservative therapy fails, liposuction is considered an effective treatment option. Prior studies often relied on subjective or non-standardized measures, limiting precision.

pmc-12675290.title: Glasses-free 3D display with ultrawide viewing range using deep learning
pmc-12675290.creator: Weijie Ma, Zhangrui Zhao, Canyu Zhao, Wanli Ouyang, Han-Sen Zhong
pmc-12675290.description: Glasses-free three-dimensional (3D) displays provide users with an immersive visual experience without the need of any wearable devices1,2. To achieve high-quality 3D imaging, a display should have both large linear dimensions and a wide viewing angle. However, the trade-off between spatial extent and bandwidth of optical systems, the space–bandwidth product, conventionally constrains the simultaneous maximization of the two.

pmc-13054854.title: Salivary Proteomics Reveals Oxidative Markers in E‑Cigarette Users
pmc-13054854.creator: Natalia de Carvalho Faria, Bruna Fernandes do Carmo Carvalho, Monica Ghislaine Oliveira Alves, Ismael Feitosa Lima, Leo Kei Iwai, Murilo Salardani, André Zelanis, Janete Dias Almeida
pmc-13054854.description: Electronic cigarettes (e-cigs) have become increasingly popular, particularly among younger populations. This study aimed to evaluate the salivary proteome of e-cig users and identify potential alterations in saliva composition. Participants were divided into the Electronic Cigarette Group (EG, n = 25 regular exclusive users) and the Control Group (CG, n = 25 nonsmokers/nonusers), matched by sex and age.

pmc-13218092.title: Follow-up monitoring, rehabilitation status and hand function recovery in patients who had a stroke at 1 year after discharge (FOLLOW-STROKE-HAND): protocol for a longitudinal observational study
pmc-13218092.creator: Fangjun Xu, Shaowei Wu, Li Mao, Shengchao Pan, Kang Zhou, Yunwei Liu, Xiaoguang Cao, Xiumin Wang
pmc-13218092.description: BackgroundStroke is the leading cause of death and disability among adults in China, with a growing disease burden. Data from the China Stroke Prevention and Treatment Report 2023 show that the incidence rate of stroke in China is approximately 246.8 per 100 000 population, with over 2 million new cases annually.

pmc-13309574.title: Exploring XDH expression as a prognostic marker for urothelial carcinoma
pmc-13309574.creator: Meng-Yun Hung, Chien-Feng Li, Hsiang-Ying Lee, Hung-Lung Ke, Yow-Ling Shiue, Hsin-Chih Yeh, Wen-Jeng Wu, Yu-Ching Wei, Wei-Ming Li
pmc-13309574.description: PurposeXanthine dehydrogenase (XDH) serves as a key enzyme in purine metabolism and plays a significant role in carcinogenesis. However, the clinical significance of XDH in urothelial carcinoma (UC) progression remains unclear. Using a transcriptomic UC database (GSE32894), we found that among the genes related to XDH activity (GO:0004854), XDH was significantly downregulated during UC progression.

uslaw-usc-t14-s524.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 5 (Functions And Powers); Subchapter II (Life Saving And Law Enforcement Authorities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Officers and members of the Coast Guard are authorized to enforce chapter 551 of title 46. The Secretary shall establish a program for these officers and members to enforce that chapter.

uslaw-usc-t54-s102901.title: 54 U.S.C. § 102901 — Conveyance of property and interests in property in System units or related areas
uslaw-usc-t54-s102901.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s102901.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 1029 (Land Transfers). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Freehold and Leasehold Interests.— With respect to any property acquired by the Secretary within a System unit or related area, except property within national parks or within national monuments of scientific significance, the Secretary may convey a freehold or leasehold interest.
